intent: Structural growth guard only; the Task 8.2D-3a.3a rebaseline adds one configured-root slot-path authority module around the existing EXTRA-synchronous WAL carrier and append-only state. An owner-controlled empty root receives a canonical immutable manifest whose expected manifest digest, random root identity, realpath, and device/inode are pinned by an opaque descriptor capability; bootstrap provisioning returns no live authority. Exact UTF-8 deployment slots use one domain-separated deterministic sharded mapping, WeakMap-branded slot capabilities remove the raw authority-state path from provision/acquire, and private lease retentions prevent premature root close. This establishes deterministic slot-path uniqueness inside one supplied configured root, while trusted launcher root selection and protected half-provision recovery remain explicit missing capabilities. Durable registration v2 binds the root instance, manifest, and mapping digests while the conditional retained BEGIN IMMEDIATE lease, hash-chained clean-release state witnesses, current non-rolled-back authority lineage, opaque protected-database pin, complete historical policies, and explicitly signing-ineligible result remain intact. This batch does not claim verified local-locking filesystem semantics, isolated same-process carrier-FD ownership, joint-snapshot anti-rollback, managed-writer quiesce, private signing, same-snapshot D2 composition, tracked holds, public publication, multi-host consensus, or an enabled external-head CLI. It adds no route, environment field, largest-file growth, or import cycle.
